vocabulary.meaning_en: the hour and minutes on a clock

vocabulary.note_ar: تُستخدم مع الساعات الكاملة فقط: one o'clock, two o'clock.
vocabulary.note_en: Only for exact hours: one o'clock, two o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after the hour (when telling the time)
vocabulary.note_ar: نستخدمها للدقائق من 1 إلى 30 بعد الساعة.
vocabulary.note_en: Use it for 1-30 minutes after the hour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: before the hour (when telling the time)
vocabulary.note_ar: نستخدمها للدقائق الباقية قبل الساعة التالية.
vocabulary.note_en: Use it for the minutes before the next hour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one of two equal parts; 30 minutes
vocabulary.example: You can have half of the pizza.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one of four equal parts; 15 minutes
leave your bed in the morning
vocabulary.example: I get up at seven o'clock.
I have breakfast at half past seven.
I have lunch at quarter past one.
I go to bed at ten o'clock.

vocabulary.note_ar: نقول at قبل الساعة: at 7:00, at half past six.
vocabulary.note_en: Use at before a clock time.
vocabulary.example: We have lunch at one o'clock.
I'm not sure. Can you tell me?

fine_lines.title: past vs to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم past للدقائق بعد الساعة (حتى النصف)، ونستخدم to للدقائق قبل الساعة التالية. 2:20 = twenty past two، و2:40 = twenty to three.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use past for minutes after the hour (up to half past). Use to for minutes before the next hour.

fine_lines.title: half past vs quarter past
fine_lines.explanation_ar: half = نصف ساعة (30 دقيقة)، وquarter = ربع ساعة (15 دقيقة). لاحظ: لا نقول half to.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Half = 30 minutes; quarter = 15 minutes. We say half past, but never "half to".

fine_lines.title: What time is it? vs What time do you ...?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What time is it? تسأل عن الوقت الآن. أما What time do you get up? فتسأل عن موعد عادة يومية، والجواب بـ at.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What time is it?" asks about the time now. "What time do you get up?" asks about a habit; answer with at + time.

examples.sentence: What time is it? It's five to three.
What time do you get up? I get up at seven.

expressions.example: What time is it? It's one o'clock.

expressions.meaning_en: another way to ask the time
expressions.example: Hello, what's the time? It's seven o'clock.

expressions.meaning_en: it is the right time to do or eat something
expressions.example: It's two o'clock. Time for lunch!

expressions.meaning_en: asking politely for part of something
expressions.example: That pizza looks good. Can I have some?
There are four of us. Let's all have a quarter.

expressions.phrase: I'm not sure. Can you tell me?
expressions.meaning_ar: لست متأكدًا. هل يمكنك أن تخبرني؟
expressions.meaning_en: you don't know and ask for help
expressions.example: What time is it? I'm not sure. Can you tell me?

expressions.phrase: What time do you get up?
expressions.example: What time do you get up? I get up at seven o'clock.

expressions.phrase: I have breakfast at twenty past seven.
expressions.meaning_ar: أتناول الفطور في السابعة وعشرين دقيقة.
expressions.meaning_en: saying the time of a daily meal
expressions.example: I have breakfast at twenty past seven.

expressions.phrase: What time do you go to bed?
expressions.example: What time do you go to bed? At half past ten.

grammar.title: Telling the time: o'clock, past, to
grammar.explanation_ar: للساعة الكاملة: It's two o'clock. للدقائق بعد الساعة (1-30) نستخدم past: It's ten past two. للدقائق قبل الساعة التالية نستخدم to: It's ten to three. و15 دقيقة = quarter، و30 دقيقة = half.
grammar.explanation_en: Exact hours: o'clock. Minutes after the hour (1-30): past. Minutes before the next hour: to. 15 minutes = quarter, 30 minutes = half.

grammar.title: at + time for daily routines
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن العادات بـ What time do you + فعل؟ ونجيب بـ I + فعل + at + الوقت.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: What time do you + verb? Answer: I + verb + at + time.
examples: What time do you get up? I get up at seven o'clock.
What time do you have lunch? I have lunch at quarter past one.
I go to bed at half past ten.

questions.question: 2:15 is ...
questions.explanation_ar: 2:15 تعني الثانية والربع = quarter past two.

questions.question: 2:45 is ...
questions.explanation_ar: 2:45 = الثالثة إلا ربعًا = quarter to three.
questions.explanation_en: 2:45 is quarter to three: 15 minutes before three.

questions.question: 2:50 is ...
questions.explanation_ar: 2:50 = الثالثة إلا عشر دقائق = ten to three.

questions.question: Complete: "I get up ___ seven o'clock."
questions.explanation_en: Use at before a clock time.

questions.question: Which question asks for the time now?
choices: What time do you get up?
What time do you go to bed?
What do you have for lunch?
questions.explanation_ar: What's the time? تسأل عن الوقت الآن.
questions.explanation_en: "What's the time?" asks about the time now.

questions.question: 2:35 is ...
questions.explanation_ar: 2:35 = الثالثة إلا خمسًا وعشرين = twenty-five to three.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: o'clock تأتي بعد الرقم ولا تُجمع.
questions.explanation_en: O'clock comes after the number and has no -s.

questions.question: "What time do you have lunch?" Choose the best answer.
choices: I have lunch at quarter past one.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن عادة، فنجيب بـ I have lunch at + الوقت.
questions.explanation_en: The question is about a habit: I have lunch at + time.

questions.question: "I'm not sure. Can you tell me?" means ...
choices: I don't know. Please help me.
questions.explanation_en: It means: I don't know; please give me the answer.
